baseline_models.focus_anchor: The future verb at word 1, the dative audience, and the vocative dual at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: A future deliberate turn concentrates action upon two classes whose title marks exceptional consequence, not a casual audience.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate turning to one matter supplies the verb's focused and intentional action.
Weight as precious rank makes the dual audience consequential rather than merely cumbersome.

changed_reading.before: A generic promise to become free for an audience.
changed_reading.after: An announced concentration upon the two classes treated as matters of exceptional consequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The future-marked form of the verb at word 1 joined to the heavy dual at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Freedom after occupation creates a threshold: prior business reaches a boundary and the heavy pair becomes the next concentrated matter.

activation_trace.role: Emptiness or freedom after occupation supplies a temporal transition rather than simple availability.
Heaviness against lightness makes the coming phase concern a load that cannot be treated lightly.

changed_reading.before: The statement only intensifies present attention.
changed_reading.after: The statement announces a coming phase boundary after which the two heavy classes become the concentrated concern.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The title at word 4 read through its weighing branch, governed by the deliberate turn at word 1.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pair is named as two weights that can be assigned measure, making the deliberate turn potentially assessive before context specifies any tribunal.

activation_trace.role: Known weight and the act of giving a thing its measure make the dual an assessable pair.
Purposeful devotion supplies the act of taking up that assessment as a distinct matter.

changed_reading.before: The dual title merely labels two species.
changed_reading.after: The title also nominates two quantities about to be taken up and given their weight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Celestial calculation, the placed balance, equity, and the ban on short measure turn the focus pair's weight into accountable measure under the same ordered regime.

activation_trace.role: Standard weight and weighing anchor the audience as subjects capable of exact assessment.
Deliberate devotion turns cosmic measure into a coming focused proceeding.
Counting and reckoning supply the calculable order within which the pair will be assessed.
The balance of justice converts physical weight into an ethical and adjudicative norm.
Equity and fair dealing specify the quality required of the coming measure.
Shorting a measure supplies the prohibited distortion that exact assessment corrects.

structural_cues: 55:5-9 moves from celestial calculation to a balance humans must not distort.
The focus title reuses the semantic material of weight after that norm has been established.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, balance, equity, and undiminished measure; I infer that this cosmic norm becomes the directional arrow toward adjudicating the named pair. A live alternative is that the title marks importance without implying a weighing proceeding.

changed_reading.before: Two important classes will receive concentrated attention.
changed_reading.after: The two classes are summoned as weights to be reckoned without distortion on the surah's universal balance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The blessing refrain immediately after the focus and the later paired recompense keep the dative from collapsing into pure menace: concentrated attention can distribute fitting outcomes to both classes.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate devotion supplies a personal settlement addressed to the pair.
Precious and protected weight preserves dignity and value in the audience title.
Benefits and favors frame the immediately preceding announcement as gift-bearing even while it warns.
A counterpart joined to its mate mirrors the focus dual and organizes outcomes in paired form.
Answering an act with its fitting recompense gives the concentrated turn a distributive purpose.
Doing what is good supplies the positive outcome that prevents settlement from meaning punishment alone.

structural_cues: The dative lakum can remain destination- or benefit-facing rather than adversative.
The dual addressees are followed by repeated dual gardens, springs, and fruit-pairs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a favor refrain, paired provisions, and act-for-act recompense; I infer that the focus turn opens a differentiated settlement with benefactive as well as punitive outcomes. A live alternative is that warning itself is the favor while the focus remains exclusively threatening.

changed_reading.before: The announcement is only a threat of attention against both classes.
changed_reading.after: The announcement is a consequential appointment for both classes in which fitting harm and fitting good can be apportioned.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creaturely cessation, divine continuance, universal petition, and activity in every span force the future phase to mean a marked mode of exclusive settlement, not prior divine busyness ending in vacancy.

activation_trace.role: Freedom after occupation supplies the apparent temporal transition that context must recalibrate.
Deliberate turning preserves the transition as concentrated purpose rather than literal inactivity.
Cessation after continuance locates the true ending on the side of creatures.
Unbroken continuance blocks a reading in which the speaker first becomes idle.
Request and petition supply the continuous field of needs preceding the focused address.
A span of time makes the activity recurrent across every temporal interval.
An affair or weighty matter supplies ongoing administration immediately before the announced turn.

structural_cues: 55:26-31 contrasts creaturely ending, divine continuance, unceasing requests, and the future address.
The focus follows continuous affair language without narrating any interval of inactivity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creaturely cessation, divine continuance, and activity in every temporal span; I infer a shift of mode from universal administration to exclusive settlement. A live alternative is rhetorical threat without any staged temporal sequence.

changed_reading.before: The speaker will finish other work and finally have spare time.
changed_reading.after: Without ceasing ongoing sovereignty, the speaker marks a future phase in which the two classes become the exclusive matter under settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Passage through cosmic sides is posed, conditioned on compelling authority, then answered by dispatched force and failed aid; focused attention therefore becomes jurisdiction from which autonomous movement cannot exit.

activation_trace.role: Breadth in movement or a road supplies the spatial possibility that the following challenge tests and closes.
Purposeful concentration supplies the governing attention that contains the attempted movement.
Clean passage to the far side defines the escape action whose autonomy is denied.
Sides and regions expand the tested boundary to the extremities of the cosmic field.
Compelling proof or warrant makes any passage dependent on authorization rather than flight.
Dispatch and emission turn the enclosing jurisdiction into active pursuit.
Aid that would make one prevail is explicitly unavailable, completing the enclosure.

structural_cues: 55:33 repeats the penetration verb as invitation, denial, and condition.
The same human-jinn pair addressed at the focus is challenged together and receives the dual-directed response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies crossing, cosmic sides, conditional warrant, dispatched force, and no aid; I infer that spatial failure reveals the scope of the focus jurisdiction. A live alternative is a capability challenge rather than a narrated attempt to flee.

changed_reading.before: The pair merely receives exclusive attention.
changed_reading.after: The pair enters an all-sided jurisdiction whose attention cannot be escaped by autonomous passage or mutual aid.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of emptying a vessel is reactivated by directed emission, metallic matter, and abundant gushing, allowing the coming turn to carry a material outpouring image with opposed punitive and generous realizations.

activation_trace.role: Pouring out a vessel supplies the material discharge image latent under the idiom of becoming free.
Physical heaviness gives the two recipients enough materiality to function as a field receiving discharge.
Sending forth supplies directed motion from source toward the dual audience.
Red metallic copper supplies the dense punitive material carried by one possible discharge.
Water springing up abundantly supplies the generous counterpart to destructive emission.

structural_cues: The focus dative leaves destination and benefit live, while 55:35 uses dual-directed force and 55:66 locates gushing within a dual provision.
The surah repeatedly alternates warning and favor under the same dual address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus's vessel-emptying branch plus later directed emission and gushing; I infer a cross-material arrow from verbal attention to outpouring into the pair's field. The materially live alternative is the ordinary idiom of exclusive attention with no discharge sense.

changed_reading.before: The verb only announces attention to the pair.
changed_reading.after: The verb may also image an imminent release directed into their shared field, realized as destructive emission or abundant provision according to outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence reverses ordinary inquiry: the pair is singled out, no one is questioned for information about guilt, offenders are already distinguished by visible marks, and apprehension follows.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate turning supplies the concentrated proceeding whose mode the later sequence clarifies.
Question and request supply the information-gathering act that the verse negates.
Guilt and wrongdoing specify what is already at issue despite the absence of questioning.
Recognition and distinction by a trace replace inquiry with immediately legible classification.
A visible identifying mark supplies the evidence by which offenders are already known.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing converts recognition into enforcement.

structural_cues: 55:39 repeats human and jinn separately, resolving the focus dual title into its two addressee classes.
Negated questioning is followed immediately by recognition and seizure rather than by evidentiary examination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies no questioning, guilt, recognition by marks, and apprehension; I infer that the focus turn is executable knowledge rather than fact-finding. A live alternative is that questioning is denied as an opportunity for excuse, not because information is unnecessary.

changed_reading.before: The coming attention resembles a summons for interrogation.
changed_reading.after: The coming attention is a proceeding in which identity and guilt are already manifest, so classification passes directly into enforcement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a fringe nominal image of the focus root rather than the normal verbal idiom; it remains anchored in word 1 and gains forensic traction from crime, taking-to-account, and recompense. Render only as a reversal image: the announcement prevents claims from going unpursued, not as a lexical translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb at word 1, read by reversal through the root's branch of blood left wasted without a claimant.

activation_trace.role: Blood allowed to go unclaimed supplies the negative possibility that the announced turn can reverse.
Crime and culpable injury supply the claims that must not disappear without consequence.
Taking someone for wrongdoing supplies active retrieval of what might otherwise go unpursued.
Act-for-act recompense supplies closure for the retrieved claim.

changed_reading.after: The coming turn may also signal that no injury or claim carried by the two classes will be left wasted and unpursued.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This competes with the stronger closure model because the following challenge denies autonomous passage but preserves passage with compelling warrant. It remains anchored in the focus root's road-breadth image and the explicit open-passage branches; render as a conditional counter-reading, never as an assurance of escape.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb at word 1 through its branch of breadth in movement, impact, or road.

activation_trace.role: A broad road or ample movement supplies the possibility of a corridor rather than enclosure alone.
An open unblocked passage supplies the concrete corridor image activated after the focus.
Compelling warrant makes the corridor authorized and conditional rather than an evasion.

changed_reading.before: Exclusive attention only closes every route.
changed_reading.after: Exclusive attention may also control and, with warrant, open the only valid corridor while autonomous penetration fails.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts the dual title from ontological importance to a bodily-affective defect in reception. It remains anchored in the title's dull-hearing branch and is activated by taught clarification followed by repeated denial; render as a diagnostic overtone of the summons, not as the title's exclusive denotation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The vocative title at word 4 through the root's branch of hearing made heavy and unreceptive.

activation_trace.role: Dullness of hearing supplies an audience whose reception is weighted down.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the intended successful reception against which heaviness is measured.
Making meaning clear by speech or sign supplies the communication the addressees resist receiving.
Contradiction of truth supplies the repeated response that makes unreceptive hearing salient.

changed_reading.before: The pair is called weighty only because of rank or burden.
changed_reading.after: The direct summons may also confront two repeatedly addressed audiences whose capacity to receive disclosure has become heavy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-material analogy, surprising because lakum does not make the pair the direct object of emptying. It remains anchored in both focus roots and is activated by the paired creations and emergence imagery; render as the disclosure of accumulated contents or consequences, not as literal pregnancy or a syntactic claim that the pair is emptied.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes a vessel-emptying branch at word 1 with pregnancy-heaviness at word 4.

activation_trace.role: Emptying a filled vessel supplies the release of something previously contained.
Pregnancy becoming heavy supplies a load whose latent contents approach manifestation.
Bringing the human creation into being supplies one member of the loaded pair.
Bringing the jinn creation into being supplies the paired counterpart with a different material origin.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the disclosure of what the paired loads contain.

changed_reading.before: The two classes stand outside the action as addressees only.
changed_reading.after: The two classes can also image burdened repositories whose accumulated contents and consequences are about to be brought into the open for them.

strongest_changes: The balance sequence changes the heavy pair into assessable weights under an undiminished cosmic measure.
The immediate finitude-continuance-affair sequence changes future freedom into a marked mode of settlement without implying divine vacancy.
The escape, recognition, and seizure sequence changes concentrated attention into closed jurisdiction that proceeds without fact-finding.
The favor and recompense sequence preserves a benefactive settlement reading alongside threat.
summary.what_was_special: The two focus roots sustain several non-collapsible mechanisms: deliberate adjudication, temporal phase change, precious paired recipients, controlled spatial passage, and a form-distant material outpouring. Later context polarizes the same address into punishment and provision rather than resolving it to one valence.
remaining_uncertainties: How much of the vessel-emptying image can color the idiomatic verb without overreading its dative construction remains uncertain.
The dual title can mark rank, measurable burden, impaired reception, or loaded containment; context strengthens several without selecting only one.
The dative may be benefactive, destinational, or simply target-oriented, so the positive settlement reading should coexist with the threat reading.
The authorized-corridor and unclaimed-blood readings are branch-grounded reversals but remain too form-distant for unqualified prose.
